final: WITH matched AS (SELECT h.player_id, p.death_state FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON h.player_id = p.player_id), state_counts AS (SELECT death_state, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM matched GROUP BY death_state), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts), kept AS (SELECT s.record_count, a.avg_count FROM state_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND s.record_count > a.avg_count) SELECT AVG(record_count), AVG(record_count - avg_count) FROM kept
